pageData.note:
Honest scope: this is a static
  gallery, not a live editor. The outputs shown are recorded by
  garnet run (regenerated by scripts/garnet_playground_build.py),
  not computed in your browser. Live in-browser execution — editing and running
  your own code — needs a WebAssembly build of the interpreter, which is on the
  roadmap (see GARNET_WASM_TARGET.md). We are not shipping a fake
  editor: when it runs in the browser, it will say so here, and not before.
